title: Ye Qing's Warning
next_chapter_hook: The identity of the mysterious helper remains unrevealed, yet he has already detected Chen Ji's feigned death—this existence more dangerous than Ling Yuan, friend or foe?

text.content: A cold, eerie laughter echoed through the decrepit wooden cabin. Chen Ji raised his head to see Ye Qing's figure coalescing from the shadows like a specter. Her gaze swept past Chen Ji, fixing directly on Ling Yuan standing in the corner. The killing intent in her eyes had almost solidified, spreading through the air like tangible frost. 'Senior Ling Yuan, long time no see.' Ye Qing's voice was clear and cold as spring water, yet carried a hint of mockery in how she pronounced 'Senior'. 'Or should I call you a "failure"?' Chen Ji remained motionless, but his fingers hidden in his sleeve had quietly tightened. The situation was more complex than he had anticipated—why would Ye Qing appear at this moment? What connection does she have with Ling Yuan?

dialogue.content: Ye Qing walked closer with each step carrying an invisible pressure. She glanced at Chen Ji, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of her lips: 'You have been setting up schemes all along, thinking the entire Tianqing Sect is on your chessboard.' Her voice carried a hint of mockery, 'Unfortunately, you miscalculated a crucial piece—Ling Yuan. He is not the dead piece you thought, but a 'reserve chess player' whose memories were sealed by the Heavenly Secrets Eye.' Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, but quickly returned to calm. He didn't press further, simply waiting for Ye Qing to continue—this woman dared to appear at this timing, she must be carrying sufficient leverage.

Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with confusion, followed by deep vigilance. He stepped forward, his voice deep: 'What does the Holy Maiden mean? The Heavenly Secrets Eye and I—' Before he could finish, Ye Qing had already laughed coldly: 'You want to say you don't remember?' Her finger lightly pointed in the air, a dark gleam flashing, 'It is because your memories were sealed! When the Covenant of Heavenly Fate was signed, you were the reserve chess player for the Tianji Record inheritance—the candidate for Chen Xuan!' Unfortunately, the Tianji Record chose Chen Ji instead of you, so the Heavenly Secrets Eye erased all related memories, turning you into this 'innocent good person' appearance.'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart missed a beat. The Tianji Record chose him instead of Ling Yuan—what did this mean? He instinctively calculated in his mind, if Ling Yuan was the reserve chess player back then, his understanding of the Tianji Record must far exceed ordinary people. Those superficial protections, those hidden arrangements... Chen Ji suddenly felt a chill. He always thought he was the chess player, now he discovered he might have been a piece on someone else's chessboard from the start. But he didn't show it, only burying this shock deep in his heart, waiting for Ye Qing to reveal more truth.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing turned to Chen Ji, a complex glint flashing in her eyes: 'You think the Covenant of Heavenly Fate is just a protection agreement?' She laughed coldly, 'Too naive. The real clause is—if Chen Ji dies before Chapter 700, Ling Yuan will automatically inherit the Tianji Record inheritance!' Chen Ji's breath finally fluctuated slightly. He recalled every time Ling Yuan's 'well-timed' interventions, those arrangements that seemed protective but actually limited his range of actions... So that was it. Ling Yuan didn't need to expose his feigned death, because he only needed to wait—wait for Chen Ji to break the rules himself, actively triggering the death condition!

Ling Yuan's expression finally changed at this moment. He looked at Chen Ji, a flicker of panic flashing in his eyes, then forcibly suppressed: 'I have no memory of what the Holy Maiden speaks of. But even so—' his voice was low and dangerous, 'If the Covenant of Heavenly Fate truly has this clause, it is Heaven's arrangement, unrelated to my will.' Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'Senior Ling Yuan is correct, this is indeed Heaven's arrangement.' He paused, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips, 'But Senior seems to have forgotten one thing—the Heavenly Secrets Eye sealed your memories, proving it does not fully trust you. Can a piece whose memories need sealing truly inherit the Tianji Record?'

text.content: Ling Yuan's pupils suddenly contracted. Chen Ji's words were like a sharp blade, precisely stabbing at the fact he least wanted to face—the Heavenly Secrets Eye never truly regarded him as a trusted subordinate, Chen Ji was the chosen one. This anger and不甘 of being abandoned surged deep in Ling Yuan's eyes, but were forcibly suppressed into dead silence. Chen Ji saw this, cold laughter in his heart: noted. When the timing is ripe, this resentment will be the best blade. Ling Yuan's restraint at this moment was not kindness, but a longer-term calculation—he was waiting for a more suitable opportunity.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing clapped her hands, her laughter like silver bells yet carrying bone-piercing cold: 'What a fine case of playing dumb to eat the tiger, Chen Ji. No wonder the Tianji Record chose you.' She turned, dark demonic energy swirling around her, 'I did not come here to watch you probe each other.' She looked at Ling Yuan, her gaze like a blade, 'I only came to remind someone—don't think your silence is mercy, your silence is only because you yourself don't know what to do. Once the Covenant of Heavenly Fate clause activates, both you and I will become puppets of the Heavenly Secrets Eye.' Having said this, she looked at Chen Ji, a warning glinting in her eyes, 'You need an ally, and I can be your choice.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately answer. He looked at Ye Qing, quickly weighing the pros and cons in his heart. Why would this Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path take the initiative to show goodwill? Her Demonic Path mist can indeed conceal the Tianji Record's aura, which is indeed tempting. But Chen Ji never believes in unearned benefits—what does Ye Qing actually want? He maintained his usual silence, under his mask-like expression was meticulous calculation. Every contact with Ye Qing, he was secretly evaluating whether this woman was a piece or an opponent. The answer might determine the future direction of the chess game.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing seemed to see through Chen Ji's顾虑, laughing lightly: 'You're wondering why I want to help you?' Her voice carried a hint of self-mockery, 'Because I too have been manipulated by the Heavenly Secrets Eye, I know the feeling of losing oneself, being used as a piece.' A shadow flickered in her eyes, 'The Holy Sect used me as a tool, Ling Yuan used me as an enemy, the Heavenly Secrets Eye used me as a chess piece—I'm fed up.' She stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, 'I can help you conceal the Tianji Record's aura, making Ling Yuan's surveillance ineffective. In exchange—I want you to help me completely break free from the Holy Sect's control.'

text.content: This was a proposal Chen Ji could not refuse. Breaking free from the Holy Sect's control—this meant Ye Qing would completely break with the Demonic Path Holy Sect, becoming a helpless existence. And a person who has completely lost all retreat often becomes the most reliable ally. But Chen Ji also knew that once he agreed, he would have to bear this responsibility. Ye Qing's fate would be tightly bound with his schemes—a double-edged sword of opportunity and risk. He must make a choice, and this choice would determine the future direction of the chess game.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's conditions were tempting enough, but Chen Ji needed to confirm her sincerity—he maintained suspicion about Ye Qing's trustworthiness, was this Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path truly worth cooperating with?

choices.description: Ye Qing's conditions were tempting enough, accepting her proposal and formally forming an alliance.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the responsibility of helping Ye Qing break free from the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: Gain the ability of Demonic Path mist to conceal the Tianji Record's aura, Ling Yuan's surveillance will be ineffective
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's true purpose has not been fully revealed, cooperation may bring unknown risks

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: 'Deal.' His voice was calm, yet carried unmistakable resolve, 'But I have one condition—you need to prove your sincerity to me. First step, tell me the latest intelligence from inside the Holy Sect.'

Ye Qing's eyes flickered with surprise, followed by appreciation: 'As expected of the one chosen by the Tianji Record.' She laughed lightly, 'The Holy Sect is planning a major event recently—they are searching for a woman named 'Chen Nian', apparently she is some kind of important 'key'.' Chen Ji's eyes suddenly sharpened.

choices.description: Agree to cooperate but maintain vigilance, requiring Ye Qing to provide more leverage first to prove her sincerity.
choices.visible_cost: Cooperation progress is relatively slow, may miss the best timing
choices.visible_reward: Test Ye Qing's sincerity without exposing all trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might feel distrusted due to Chen Ji's caution

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately, but glanced meaningfully at Ling Yuan before turning to Ye Qing: "Cooperation is possible, but I need to see your sincerity first." A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth, "For example—tell me everything you know about Ling Yuan."

text.content: Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to make such a request. But she quickly laughed, the sound carrying admiration: "Good, I like smart people." She turned to look at Ling Yuan, eyes full of playfulness, "Ling Yuan senior, would you like to know what I heard about you in the Holy Sect?"

choices.description: Although Ye Qing's conditions were tempting, Chen Ji decided to remain independent, avoiding any entanglements with the Demonic Path forces.
choices.visible_cost: Without the protection of the Demonic Path fog, Ling Yuan's surveillance will remain effective
choices.visible_reward: Maintain an independent identity, free from being controlled by any faction
choices.risk_hint: May provoke Ye Qing, turning a potential ally into an enemy

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his voice cold: "I appreciate the Saintess's kindness, but I'm accustomed to working alone." His gaze swept over Ye Qing and Ling Yuan, a sneer curling at the corner of his mouth, "Besides—I already have a 'watcher,' and I don't need another 'cooperator.'"

Ye Qing's smile froze for a moment, then turned into a sigh: "Pity." Her voice carried a hint of regret, "But it doesn't matter, I can wait." She turned to walk toward the door, her steps still composed, "But I must remind you of one thing—the mysterious helper has already discovered your feigned death, and he is more dangerous than Ling Yuan."

text.content: After Ye Qing left, only Chen Ji and Ling Yuan remained in the wooden cabin. Silence wrapped around them like an invisible net. Ling Yuan's expression had already returned to its usual calm, as if nothing had just happened. But Chen Ji knew this was merely the surface—Ling Yuan's mind must be racing, reassessing the threat level of this "waste" disciple. Chen Ji was pondering the same question: what did Ling Yuan's silence mean? Was he acknowledging Ye Qing's words, or waiting for the next opportunity to strike? This game of chess had just begun.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan finally spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Chen Ji, you truly are not simple." His gaze was profound as an abyss, as if trying to see through Chen Ji, "But I must tell you something—no matter what Ye Qing said, I have no designs on the Tianji Record." Chen Ji said nothing, merely watching him silently. Ling Yuan continued: "I have guarded Tianqing Sect for three hundred years, never wavering. If you are willing, we can become allies." The words sounded sincere, but Chen Ji inwardly冷笑: noted. The more Ling Yuan appeared magnanimous, the more it proved he had ulterior motives.

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes slightly, looking at Ling Yuan's sincere expression—if it wasn't an act. He quickly analyzed in his mind: Ling Yuan's proactive goodwill at this moment could only mean two things. First, he truly wanted to recruit Chen Ji, since Ye Qing had already revealed his cards and he needed to rebuild trust. Second, he was testing Chen Ji's reactions, looking for exploitable weaknesses. Regardless of which possibility, Chen Ji needed to act appropriately—neither too wary to arouse suspicion nor too trusting to fall into a trap. He decided to use the safest approach: accept on the surface, remain vigilant in secret.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan suddenly proposed an alliance, and Chen Ji must decide how to deal with this existence that could be either enemy or ally

choices.text: Accept the alliance on the surface
choices.description: Agree to ally with Ling Yuan, but remain secretly vigilant and continue gathering evidence against him.
choices.visible_cost: Must constantly guard against Ling Yuan's betrayal
choices.visible_reward: Stabilize Ling Yuan to buy time for subsequent scheming
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may also be scheming in the shadows, waiting for the right moment

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then nodded: "Since Ling Yuan senior has such sincerity, Chen Ji shall comply." His voice was calm, showing no emotional fluctuations, "But I have one condition—I need to see the original text of the Heavenly Fate Pact with my own eyes."

Ling Yuan's eyes flickered, then nodded: "Agreed." His voice remained calm, "But not now—some things require the right timing." A slight smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, and he said nothing more. Timing? Fine, he would wait.

choices.description: Directly question Ling Yuan about the truth of the Heavenly Fate Pact and the backup chess player, giving him no chance to hide anything.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke Ling Yuan, destroying the surface relationship
choices.visible_reward: Force Ling Yuan to reveal more of his cards
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might completely turn to the opposing side because of this.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, staring directly into Ling Yuan's eyes: "Ling Yuan Senior, is Ye Qing's claim about the backup Chess Player true?" His voice was not loud, yet it carried an inescapable pressure. "Why did you fail back then? Why did the Eye of Heavenly Way seal your memories? How many things are you still hiding from me?"

Ling Yuan fell silent for a long time. When he spoke again, weariness filled his voice: "Some things... I don't want to hide them, but I simply don't remember them myself." His gaze turned profound. "If you want to find the answers, perhaps you should ask someone—Chen Nian." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

choices.description: Not responding to Ling Yuan's proposal directly, choosing to express attitude through silence and actions.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as weakness or evasion
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining strategic ambiguity, preventing Ling Yuan from judging true intentions
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might take advantage of the opportunity to act

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely nodded slightly, then turned and walked toward the door. His back was calm and unhurried, as if Ling Yuan's proposal wasn't worth his consideration at all. Ling Yuan watched his retreating figure, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes—this "waste" disciple was far more difficult to deal with than he had imagined.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to step across the threshold, Ling Yuan's voice came from behind him: "Chen Ji, there is one thing I can tell you—your sister Chen Nian, she is still alive." Chen Ji's foot paused, but he did not look back. Ling Yuan continued: "The Holy Sect won't kill her easily, because there is something... special about her." Chen Ji's fingers tightened imperceptibly in his sleeve, yet his voice remained calm: "Many thanks to the Senior for informing me." With that, he strode away, leaving Ling Yuan's gaze behind him.

Night wind blew through the window cracks, carrying the chill of late autumn. Chen Ji stood in the shadows outside the wooden hut, gazing up at the stars in the sky. His heart churned like surging undercurrents—Ye Qing's intelligence, Ling Yuan's implications, Chen Nian's existence... all of it rapidly integrated, deduced, and strategized within his mind. The Tianji Record in his body radiated gentle warmth, as if the fragmented pages were responding to his thoughts. Chen Nian... his sister who had been missing for years, was actually connected to the Heavenly Fate Agreement, to Ling Yuan, to all of this. She was the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," her existence interfering with the Tianji Record's foresight—what did this mean? Chen Ji closed his eyes, calculating silently in his heart: no matter how perilous the path ahead, he would find Chen Nian and uncover the truth of all this. This was his obsession as a brother, and also his inevitable choice as a Chess Player. In the night sky, the stars silently gazed upon this land, and Chen Ji's chess game had only just entered the middle game.

dialogue.content: At that moment, a cold voice drifted from the night wind—the returning Ye Qing: "I forgot to tell you something." Her figure emerged from the shadows, her eyes carrying a hint of solemnity. "That mysterious helper... he is not a person, but an organization. Their codename is the 'Tianji Pavilion'—reportedly, all members are former candidates who were rejected from the Tianji Record." She paused, her voice dropping lower. "And their leader, reportedly, was once the previous master of the Tianji Record."

text.content: Tianji Pavilion. Chen Ji carved this name into his mind, weaving it together with Ling Yuan, Chen Nian, and the Heavenly Fate Agreement into the giant web in his heart. Ye Qing had already vanished into the night, leaving only her final words echoing in the wind: "Be careful of them... their purpose may be even more dangerous than Ling Yuan's." Chen Ji stood in the night wind, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth. Dangerous? From the moment he embarked on this path, he had never feared danger. The Tianji Record had chosen him, Ling Yuan watched from the shadows, Ye Qing proactively formed an alliance, and the Tianji Pavilion moved in secret... all of this was within his expectations, yet also beyond them. But it was fine. The more complex the chess game, the more excited he became.

It was deep into the night. Chen Ji, the Servant Disciple of Tianqing Sect, walked slowly through the corridor, appearing no different from usual—the same submissive, meek demeanor. But only he knew that after tonight, everything had changed. Ye Qing's intelligence had revealed Ling Yuan's true colors, the hidden terms of the Heavenly Fate Agreement had shown him his situation, and the news about Chen Nian... had reignited the flame that had been suppressed in his heart for years. Sister, wait for me. No matter the ends of the earth, no matter what price I must pay, I will definitely find you. He raised his head, his gaze piercing through the night sky as if seeing some unknown place far away. The stars were silent, but Chen Ji's chess game had quietly escalated.
